metadata.title: Marvell slips as investors consider Google deal, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
3 hours ago
Marvell slips as investors consider Google deal, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Friday's premarket action:
Marvell Technology's stock tumbled 8% as despite the semiconductor company raising its revenue for fiscal years 2027 and 2028, investors were proved disappointed by management's announcement that the "big impact" of its new chip-making deal with Alphabet's Google would not be felt until 2029.
Shares in PayPal declined 13% on a Bloomberg report that a consortium of Advent and Stripe moved to abandon its planned pursuit of the online payment system.
A number of chipmakers fell following Marvell's post-closing bell earnings on Thursday as traders' sentiment toward the sector once again soured. Intel shed over 2%, while Nvidia was down about 1% and Micron Technology down 2%.
Iren slumped almost 7% after the renewable energy data center provider reported a $684 million net loss in its fourth quarter. The Sydney-headquartered company posted revenue of $137.2 million, below analysts' expectations of $157.14 million.
